name: Networking fundamentals
description: Studying TCP/IP, Ethernet, MAC addressing, and IPv4/IPv6 networking concepts.

name: Switching
description: Learning how switches forward frames and use MAC address tables, VLANs, and Spanning Tree Protocol.

name: Routing and IP Connectivity
description: Building knowledge of IP routing, default gateways, and how devices communicate across networks.

name: Network Troubleshooting
description: Learning to trace how network traffic moves and use that understanding to investigate connectivity problems.

name: Cisco Packet Tracer
description: Beginning to apply CCNA concepts in simulated network topologies and document lab work.
